matching: An item counts as a reminder when its name matches an entry's name (or alias) and, in systems that say so (dnd5e), its activation is a legendary or lair action. Entries of kind 'hit' (traits and reactions such as Heated Body or Parry) need no activation; their optional 'activation' (dnd5e activation type the item must have) and 'requires' (text its description must contain) tell them apart from same-named features of the other edition, and 'attack' is 'melee' (default) or 'any' (ranged hits too). A legendary or lair activation always wins over a 'hit' entry. match 'exact' ignores case, apostrophe style and text in parentheses; 'contains' matches anywhere in the item's name. Entries of kind 'death' (Undead Fortitude, Death Burst, Relentless Endurance...) also need no activation; they are checked when the creature drops to 0 HP, and a legendary or lair activation wins over them too. The same goes for 'turn' (start or end of its own turn: 'phase', 'stopTypes' damage types that stop it, 'hpAtMost'), 'aura' (another creature starts its turn within 'rangeFt'), 'bloodied' (it drops to half HP or less; features whose description says what changes 'while Bloodied' count too), 'damage' ('damageTypes' it reacts to, or 'threshold' damage in one turn), 'save' ('abilities', empty for every save) and 'spell' (a creature within 'rangeFt' casts a spell). Mythic actions are found by their dnd5e activation ('mythic').

kinds.legendary: Legendary action: used right after another creature's turn, spending legendary action uses
kinds.lair: Lair action (2014): used on initiative count 20, losing ties
kinds.hit: When hit: a trait or reaction that triggers when the creature is hit by an attack, melee only unless 'attack' is 'any' (dnd5e attack rolls with a target)
kinds.death: Death trigger: a feature that matters when the creature drops to 0 HP or dies (checked on the creature that dropped)
kinds.mythic: Mythic action: on the legendary action card once the creature's mythic trait has triggered in the combat (dnd5e activation 'mythic')
kinds.turn: Turn trait: at the start (or, with phase 'end', the end) of the creature's own turn
kinds.aura: Aura: when another creature starts its turn within rangeFt
kinds.bloodied: Bloodied: when the creature drops to half its HP or less
kinds.damage: Damage trait: damage of one of damageTypes, or threshold damage in one turn (dnd5e)
kinds.save: Saving throw trait: before the creature rolls a save of one of abilities (dnd5e)
kinds.spell: Spell reaction: when an opposing creature within rangeFt casts a spell (dnd5e)
kinds.custom: Added by the GM from an item's context menu

Their id is 'death-' + that module's id; deathListVersion is the version of that module's list the entry was added in (no deathListVersion means 1). Both are used once, to move a world's old Death Trigger list into the Reminder list.

features.name: Regeneration
features.effect: Regains HP at the start of its turn; its stat block says how many and what stops it (fire, acid, radiant damage...).

features.name: Regeneration
features.effect: Regains 10 HP at the start of its turn. If it took acid or fire damage, this doesn't work at the start of its next turn. It dies only if it starts its turn with 0 HP and doesn't regenerate.

features.name: Regeneration
features.effect: Regains 20 HP (spawn: 10) at the start of its turn if it has at least 1 HP and isn't in sunlight or running water. Radiant damage or holy water stops it at the start of its next turn.

features.name: Berserk
features.effect: Whenever it starts its turn with 40 HP or fewer, roll a d6. On a 6 it goes berserk: each turn it attacks the nearest creature it can see (or an object), until it is destroyed or regains all its HP. Its creator can try to calm it (DC 15 Persuasion within 60 ft).

features.name: Berserk
features.effect: Whenever it starts its turn with 60 HP or fewer, roll a d6. On a 6 it goes berserk: each turn it attacks the nearest creature it can see (or an object), until it is destroyed or regains all its HP.

features.name: Multiple Heads
features.effect: At the end of its turn it grows two heads for each head that died since its last turn, unless it took fire damage since its last turn, and regains 10 HP per head regrown. A head dies when it takes 25 or more damage in a single turn.

features.name: Stench
features.effect: A creature that starts its turn nearby makes a Con save or is poisoned until the start of its next turn; the DC and range are in the stat block.

features.name: Stench
features.effect: A creature that starts its turn within 5 ft makes a DC 10 Con save or is poisoned until the start of its next turn. On a success it is immune to this ghast's Stench for 24 hours.

features.name: Stench
features.effect: A creature other than a troglodyte that starts its turn within 5 ft makes a DC 12 Con save or is poisoned until the start of its next turn. On a success it is immune to the Stench of all troglodytes for 1 hour.

features.name: Stench
features.effect: A creature that starts its turn within 10 ft makes a DC 14 Con save or is poisoned until the start of its next turn. On a success it is immune to the hezrou's Stench for 24 hours.

features.name: Lightning Absorption
features.effect: Whenever it is subjected to lightning damage, it takes no damage and instead regains HP equal to the lightning damage dealt.

features.name: Fire Absorption

features.name: Acid Absorption
features.effect: Whenever it is subjected to acid damage, it takes no damage and instead regains HP equal to the acid damage dealt.

features.name: Split
features.effect: When a Medium or larger one with at least 10 HP is subjected to lightning or slashing damage, it splits into two new ones, each with half its HP (rounded down) and one size smaller.

features.name: Swallow
features.effect: If it takes enough damage on a single turn from a creature inside it (usually 30), it makes a Con save at the end of that turn or regurgitates everything it swallowed, who fall prone within 10 ft. The threshold and DC are in its stat block.

features.name: Swallow
features.effect: If it takes 30 or more damage on a single turn from a creature inside it, it makes a DC 14 Con save at the end of that turn or regurgitates all swallowed creatures, who fall prone within 10 ft.

features.name: Swallow
features.effect: If it takes 30 or more damage on a single turn from a creature inside it, it makes a DC 15 Con save at the end of that turn or regurgitates all swallowed creatures, who fall prone within 10 ft.

features.name: Swallow
features.effect: If it takes 60 or more damage on a single turn from a creature inside it, it makes a DC 20 Con save at the end of that turn or regurgitates all swallowed creatures, who fall prone within 10 ft.

features.name: Absorb Elements
features.effect: Reaction when it takes acid, cold, fire, lightning or thunder damage: resistance to that type until the start of its next turn, including against the damage just taken (give back half of it).

features.name: Magic Resistance
features.effect: Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

features.name: Evasion
features.effect: On a Dex save for half damage it takes no damage on a success and only half on a failure.

features.name: Turn Resistance
features.effect: Advantage on saving throws against effects that turn undead.

features.name: Turning Defiance

features.name: Gnome Cunning
features.effect: Advantage on Int, Wis and Cha saving throws against magic.

features.name: Counterspell

features.name: Shield
features.effect: Reaction when hit by an attack (or targeted by magic missile): +5 AC until the start of its next turn, including against the triggering attack.

creatures.name: Aboleth
regionalEffects: Underground surfaces within 1 mile are slimy difficult terrain.
Water within 1 mile is fouled; its enemies who drink it vomit.
Can project an illusory image of itself within 1 mile.

regionalEffects: A non-evil creature takes 3d10 necrotic the first time it enters the tomb.
Monsters in the tomb have advantage on saves against charm, fear and turn undead.

creatures.name: Adult Black Dragon

lair.rule: Can't use the same lair action two rounds in a row.

regionalEffects: Land within 6 miles takes twice as long to cross (thick plants, mud).

Fog lightly obscures land within 6 miles.
creatures.notes: Lair actions and regional effects are in the Monster Manual, not the SRD.
